reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The Loan will finance the expansion of the Group's rail terminal in western Ukraine near the border with Poland, including the development of a grain transhipment complex and container yards facility. Part of the loan proceeds (estimated amount of EUR 3.8 million or 28% of total project cost) will be applied to finance expenditures incurred by the Company before the signing of the loan agreement (retroactive financing), including construction costs and purchase of equipment. The Project will improve Ukraine's transport connectivity with the EU by addressing the shortage of modern transhipment capacity at the Ukrainian / Polish border, which is one of the key infrastructure bottlenecks. Since the beginning of the war on 24th February 2022, Ukraine has been facing major disruptions to its economy and supply chains from the attacks on critical infrastructure and the blockade of its sea ports by Russia. The Project will facilitate the development of alternative transportation routes for grain exports from Ukraine and the container flows between Ukraine and the EU, which is of vital importance due to the ongoing war.
